When Dylan Ervin's daughter started walking, everything in their house moved up a shelf. Everything except the pistol in his nightstand drawer.

Every lockbox he tried made him choose: locked, or within reach. A keypad to find in the dark. A fingerprint reader that had to recognize him half asleep. A battery to remember.

So in 2016 he built his own, in Spokane, WA.

The StopBox® Pro is 100% mechanical. No batteries. No electronics. No keys to lose. Press your finger sequence in one motion and it opens in under one second with practice, even in the dark.
